room_identity: A library that stopped mid-use. Paper is the material here; bone is the note.

provenance.brief_checked_out: Unlike NSC-081's and NSC-083's, this brief's numbers agree with the committed data: shelf segments draw 1.69 / 1.66 / 1.72 ('about 1.7 each'), the lectern draws 2.34, and the north strip is 2.75 deep. Nothing needed correcting.

builder_contract.pivot: Committed pivot and PPU from PropCatalog.json; the builder never recomputes one.
builder_contract.y_is_always_zero: Every placement sits on the floor at y=0. A book stack 'on a shelf top' is placed on the shelf's FOOTPRINT and reads as on the shelf through sorting order - it is not lifted in Y.
builder_contract.sorting: sorting_order = round((x - z) * 10); larger x-z is nearer the camera.
builder_contract.colliders: The dressing prefab carries NO colliders.
builder_contract.lie_within_props: shared_bone_pile_b is the room's only lie_within entry.

clearance_proved.lanes: All four lanes swept every 0.5 units of z against the 2.5 minimum. Lane 3 is pinched to exactly 2.5 by the reading table, which is deliberate and is why nothing else may enter it.
clearance_proved.reading_table: Asserted to occupy CollapsedFurnitureBA1 EXACTLY, and asserted that nothing is skirted within 0.5 of it. One unit of spill makes lane 3 illegal, so there is no margin here at all.
clearance_proved.shelf_runs: Each bank is asserted gap-free in DRAWN width across its whole footprint.
clearance_proved.paper_beats_bone: Asserted: paper props outnumber bone props, so the room stays a library rather than becoming a charnel house and stealing the Chapel of Ash's and the Final Room's distinction.

props.intent: the room's one piece of furniture and DELIBERATELY the pinch in lane 3. Its 1.00 x 2.00 footprint is exactly CollapsedFurnitureBA1, so there is no margin at all - and nothing is skirted around it, which is the habit that would be right anywhere else in this project
